live.step: D2 models match the migration: zero column-level drift on the four ARCH-45 tables

D3 schema refusals: document count, status/time pairs, hashes, encoder, counts, one live run per fingerprint, position trigger, cross-workspace FK, canonical pairs, severity bands, layer/kind, evidence trigger, decisions; a deleted document takes its comparisons
D4 request -> job -> COMPLETED: 9/9 planted found and nothing else material; trigger once; reversed order served from the cache (no job); a clean pair emits nothing and stays out of the hub

D5 HTTP: 402 on all 11 routes (+denial audit); list/detail/cached POST (200); PDF/CSV/JSON (audited); page PNG no-store; 422s; decide; review -> hub RESOLVED, then 409; rules; document panel; delete 204

D6 invalidation: reprocessing a document marks its comparison STALE (changed_since on that document only); the next request recomputes with the new text; an unchanged reprocess keeps it; force supersedes; a table correction invalidates
D7 ARCH-42 roots: two records for the insured are a material ENTITY_MISMATCH; after a merge the comparison is stale and the recomputed one follows merged_into_id to one party
D8 ARCH-33 workspace rules: the latest deterministic definition applies (RULE_CONFLICT carries its id); the llm definition is listed as skipped; leaving them out is a different comparison

D9 job: without the plan -> FAILED with the reason, refresh re-queues; the SentenceTransformer path (stand-in model) finds every planted clause/field difference; a model that cannot load falls back with a note; an engine error -> FAILED
D10 review hub: a comparison with material differences is a CORROBORATION item; CONFIRM through resolution decides them all -> RESOLVED; bulk DISMISS; the kind is hidden without the plan
D11 sweep: a silent change is caught (dry run changes nothing), stuck runs FAIL, abandoned STALE runs are deleted, reviewed ones kept
D12 ARCH-20 erasure: a subject's documents take every comparison (and every quoted value) with them

results.gate: T1 capability: entitlements (+Entitlement), 402 name, Enterprise only, console + plan card, nav lock, verify36, hardening matrix
T2 migration: 4 tables, live-fingerprint index, triggers, CHECKs, arch44 -> arch45 -> contract, one head, hub view v6, vocabulary parity
G1 normalisation: typed values (money, percent, dates DMY/MDY, IDs, 'forty-five (45)'), formatting-only edits read alike, negation
G2 segmentation: numbered clauses, running headers/footers and field lines dropped, a clause across a page break is one
G3 alignment: Hungarian == brute-force optimum on 300 random matrices; split paragraphs absorbed; N-way groups one unit per document
G4 golden sets: every planted difference found (recall 100%) and nothing else material (precision 100%)
G5 held-out seeds 201-260 (120 sets): recall and precision 100%
G6 order independence: every permutation of 2, 3 and 4 documents gives the identical result
G7 materiality: changed values and flipped obligations material, rewording never; missing clause HIGH; formatting/moves/splits silent; bands
G8 rules: ARCH-33 deterministic plans (llm refused), RULE_CONFLICT / RULE_VALUE, agreement silent, re-hydration
G9 cache keys: set hash order-free; content hash moves with text, boxes, fields, table revision/rejection, entity roots
G10 report: PDF (Helvetica metrics, every document and difference, page n of m), CSV (injection-safe), JSON
G11 encoders: lexical deterministic; the encoder is chosen without importing sentence_transformers; fallback is noted
W1 wiring: job on ENRICH, invalidation hooks (reprocess + tables), erasure, trigger (19/20), conformance 19, hub gated, router, sweep
W2 API: 11 routes, each gated first; writes CONTRIBUTOR, reads VIEWER; renderings no-store; exports audited
W3 console: type parity (16 models + 5 unions), locked pages, authorized page images, matrix, word diff, synchronized panes, hub
